grammar.title: The 把 disposal sentence
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 其他成分
grammar.explanation: 把 (bǎ) moves the object in front of the verb when you want to emphasize what happens to it. The verb can't stand alone after 把 — it usually needs a complement, 了, or a repeated verb to show the result. This structure is common whenever an action changes, moves, or finishes something specific.

grammar.title: The 被 passive sentence
grammar.pattern: 受事 + 被 + (施事) + 动词 + 其他成分
grammar.explanation: 被 (bèi) marks the passive voice: the subject is the receiver of the action, not the doer. The person or thing doing the action can go right after 被, or be left out if it isn't important. Like 把, the verb after 被 usually needs a complement or 了 to sound complete.

sentences.zh: 她把手机放在桌子上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shǒujī fàng zài zhuōzi shàng le.
sentences.en: She put her phone on the table.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū huán gěi nǐ.
sentences.en: I'll give this book back to you.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī bèi tā ná zǒu le.
sentences.en: My phone was taken away by him.

sentences.pinyin: Mén bèi fēng chuī kāi le.
sentences.en: The door was blown open by the wind.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bèi tā jiè zǒu le.
sentences.en: This book was borrowed by him.

sentences.pinyin: Cài bèi tā chī wán le.
sentences.en: The food was all eaten by him.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shǒujī nòng huài le.

sentences.zh: 他把房子改成了办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ fángzi gǎi chéng le bàngōngshì.
sentences.en: He converted the house into an office.

sentences.zh: 我把这个故事写成了一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhège gùshi xiě chéng le yī běn shū.
sentences.en: I wrote this story into a book.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū sòng gěi le tā.
sentences.en: I gave this book to him.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhàopiàn fā gěi le wǒ.
sentences.en: She sent the photo to me.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chē mài gěi le péngyou.
sentences.en: He sold the car to a friend.

sentences.pinyin: Tā suǒ shuō de huà hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.en: What he said is very important.

sentences.zh: 这不是我所希望的结果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù shì wǒ suǒ xīwàng de jiéguǒ.
sentences.en: This isn't the result I hoped for.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.en: Please put the book on the table.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ chē tíng zài ménkǒu.
sentences.en: She parked the car at the entrance.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ mén tuī kāi le.
